Summary: Risk-based evidence completeness checklist for QA sign-off or recommendation.
EntryCriteria: Implementation evidence is available and QA review is underway.
ExitCriteria: Evidence pack is decision-ready with open defects and residual risk clearly stated.
Checks: Covered behaviors and uncovered behaviors are both explicit.
Automated evidence is reproducible and linked to the reviewed build or artifact set.
Manual or exploratory findings are captured with severity and follow-up.
Environment limitations affecting confidence are disclosed.
Residual quality risk is written in go/no-go language.
Defects are triaged, not just listed.
